name: Calvin Wylde
caption: The fictional owner and C.E.O. of Gateway City Wrestling, credited in the fed's own founding guide with putting up the money and connections behind the promotion.
notes: A purely fictional business figure (the founding guide's own 'FICTIONALLY...' staff list names him C.E.O.; he does not appear on the 'IN REALITY' staff list, so no real person corresponds to this name). Kayfabe backstory: the younger brother of a named former DPW/GFWA tag star, he bankrolls the promotion.

name: Commissioner Hyatt
caption: Gateway City Wrestling's founder and self-inserted on-air Commissioner and face commentator, wrestling under his own name as he had on a prior fed's review show.
notes: Self-inserted founder/operator: the fed's own founding guide lists him on BOTH its 'FICTIONALLY...' staff list (as GCW Commissioner/announcer) and its 'IN REALITY...' staff list (as President/Writer) -- the same name used as both the real operator and the on-air character.

name: Rob Scatterson
caption: Gateway City Wrestling's fictional heel color commentator, announced alongside the fed's own self-inserted Commissioner in its founding guide.
notes: A purely fictional on-air figure (the founding guide's own 'FICTIONALLY...' staff list names him as color commentator; he does not appear on the 'IN REALITY' staff list, so no real person corresponds to this name).
